approvedHook: Can I reuse Chatterbox audio after changing my script?
approvedCta: Follow for more on growing your business with AI.
narration: Can I reuse Chatterbox audio after changing my script?
I check each segment. A saved recording can still contain words from an earlier script.
In one recorded Fused run, our wrapper reused 7 segments and generated none. This is not a benchmark.
Chatterbox makes speech. Our wrapper checks whether saved audio matches its recorded inputs. Those are separate jobs.
I check exact text, voice reference, generation settings, and saved audio before reusing a segment.
In this labeled demonstration, identical inputs give the same key. Editing the sentence changes it. No new speech was generated.
Our tech wrapper also checks the actual voice reference bytes, not just a file path.
A changed line needs new speech. Unchanged segments stay only when their checks pass.
So I keep matching narration and replace changed narration. An existing filename cannot make that decision.
Follow for more on growing your business with AI.
